item.description:
This version of Read You Well, one of the lead singles from Vedo’s Album “e•pit•o•me” was released by accident, and despite the metadata saying (feat. Akeem Ali), it was just Vedo solo and had a 2nd verse from him in place of the Akeem Ali feature. The master then got replaced with the current version with Akeem on all streaming services the next day.
